title: Bloom
description: A friendly neighbourhood salon: blush, lilac and mint, rounded type, soft blobs and pill buttons.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: Good hair days, for the whole family
tokens.HERO_LEDE: Cuts, colour and first haircuts in a bright studio where nobody minds if you bring the pram.
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: Bloom is a small team of four on the corner of Example Street. We cut toddlers, teenagers, parents and grandparents, often on the same Saturday.
tokens.QUOTE: The best compliment is a child who asks to come back.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A family hair studio. Step-free, pram-friendly and open on Saturdays.
